brand.name: Ghost
brand.description:
When you purchase a Ghost product, you are truly buying something different. Ghost is a small artisan cultivator with deep roots going back to the Michigan Caregiver days. A legacy brand, Ghost has remained family owned and true to its original grow techniques.  There are very few companies that have remained completely dirt, soil, and coco free.  Ghost products are grown in 100% water, that’s it.

Famous for our phenotype of the Garlic Cookies strain (testing as high as 41% total cannabinoids), Ghost flavors hit you in a number of ways. A well rounded genetic library features very different terpene profiles, THC levels, and flower structure.  Ghost is the perfect mix of having options for smokers or all types, without chasing some “new celebrity” flavor of the week.  Ghost's cultivar rotation is smaller than the big box brands, allowing us to bring customers excellent quality.

brand.name: Blue River
brand.description:
Blue River believes that cannabis products should be made naturally and without the use of chemicals, solvents, gases, additives, artificial fragrances, GMOs, or fillers. Our vision is to provide the world’s finest farm-to-table authentic cannabis experiences through our proprietary terpene extraction technology, cannabis manufacturing innovation, and trademark-branded solventless products. Our company’s ethos is rooted in corporate social responsibility as it pertains to the cannabis industry, with a focus on repairing the disproportionate impacts of the War on Drugs. 

Blue River™ originated as the world’s first cannabis-derived terpene company aiding in the popularization of the word “Terps”. Blue River™ has received over 59 Cannabis Awards for our innovative solventless technology, trademark branded products, and advanced patented formulations.

brand.description:
Born in Boulder, Colorado in 2010 as an original cannabis-infused beverage company, Keef Brands is a leader and a crowd favorite amongst the rapidly growing THC beverage space. 

Inspired by the notion of combining the celebratory and social experience of drinking with the magic and joy of cannabis, Keef's mission is to offer a new generation of consumers an alternative to alcohol and an innovative way to enjoy life while remixing the expectation of what cannabis is and should be. 

With a suite of award-winning and great tasting products, Keef has expanded its presence to 13 legal cannabis markets across North America including Canada and Puerto Rico making it the leading cannabis beverage brand in the country. 

Keef invites everyone – friends, family, newcomers, old-timers, CannaSeurs and CannaCurious – to join us in raising their glasses to the new era of cannabis consumption. To learn more, please visit www.keefbrands.com.

brand.name: Ghost
brand.description:
When you purchase a Ghost product, you are truly buying something different. Ghost is a small artisan cultivator with deep roots going back to the Michigan Caregiver days. A legacy brand, Ghost has remained family owned and true to its original grow techniques.  There are very few companies that have remained completely dirt, soil, and coco free.  Ghost products are grown in 100% water, that’s it.

Famous for our phenotype of the Garlic Cookies strain (testing as high as 41% total cannabinoids), Ghost flavors hit you in a number of ways. A well rounded genetic library features very different terpene profiles, THC levels, and flower structure.  Ghost is the perfect mix of having options for smokers or all types, without chasing some “new celebrity” flavor of the week.  Ghost's cultivar rotation is smaller than the big box brands, allowing us to bring customers excellent quality.

brand.name: Blue River
brand.description:
Blue River believes that cannabis products should be made naturally and without the use of chemicals, solvents, gases, additives, artificial fragrances, GMOs, or fillers. Our vision is to provide the world’s finest farm-to-table authentic cannabis experiences through our proprietary terpene extraction technology, cannabis manufacturing innovation, and trademark-branded solventless products. Our company’s ethos is rooted in corporate social responsibility as it pertains to the cannabis industry, with a focus on repairing the disproportionate impacts of the War on Drugs. 

Blue River™ originated as the world’s first cannabis-derived terpene company aiding in the popularization of the word “Terps”. Blue River™ has received over 59 Cannabis Awards for our innovative solventless technology, trademark branded products, and advanced patented formulations.

brand.name: Keef
brand.description:
Born in Boulder, Colorado in 2010 as an original cannabis-infused beverage company, Keef Brands is a leader and a crowd favorite amongst the rapidly growing THC beverage space. 

Inspired by the notion of combining the celebratory and social experience of drinking with the magic and joy of cannabis, Keef's mission is to offer a new generation of consumers an alternative to alcohol and an innovative way to enjoy life while remixing the expectation of what cannabis is and should be. 

With a suite of award-winning and great tasting products, Keef has expanded its presence to 13 legal cannabis markets across North America including Canada and Puerto Rico making it the leading cannabis beverage brand in the country. 

Keef invites everyone – friends, family, newcomers, old-timers, CannaSeurs and CannaCurious – to join us in raising their glasses to the new era of cannabis consumption. To learn more, please visit www.keefbrands.com.

Olio's mission is to provide delicious, beautiful, clean and potent concentrate to folks who love smoking hash as much as they do!

They hope to be a glowing example of how to operate and lead the way in this uncharted territory.

With a commitment to quality and consistency, Sublime began producing small-batch edibles and craft concentrates in their kitchen and lab produciton facilities. Sublime has since expanded across the country, achieving success in multiple markets by producing everything from edibles and flower to topicals and concentrates. Through replicating its state-of-the-art facilities, unparalleled quality control, and expert standard operating procedures in all new ventures, Sublime has become a leading multistate operator in the cannabis industry. As Sublime continues to grow, the brand is committed to upholding consistency and excellence.

brand.name: Blue River
brand.description:
Blue River believes that cannabis products should be made naturally and without the use of chemicals, solvents, gases, additives, artificial fragrances, GMOs, or fillers. Our vision is to provide the world’s finest farm-to-table authentic cannabis experiences through our proprietary terpene extraction technology, cannabis manufacturing innovation, and trademark-branded solventless products. Our company’s ethos is rooted in corporate social responsibility as it pertains to the cannabis industry, with a focus on repairing the disproportionate impacts of the War on Drugs. 

Blue River™ originated as the world’s first cannabis-derived terpene company aiding in the popularization of the word “Terps”. Blue River™ has received over 59 Cannabis Awards for our innovative solventless technology, trademark branded products, and advanced patented formulations.

brand.name: Keef
brand.description:
Born in Boulder, Colorado in 2010 as an original cannabis-infused beverage company, Keef Brands is a leader and a crowd favorite amongst the rapidly growing THC beverage space. 

Inspired by the notion of combining the celebratory and social experience of drinking with the magic and joy of cannabis, Keef's mission is to offer a new generation of consumers an alternative to alcohol and an innovative way to enjoy life while remixing the expectation of what cannabis is and should be. 

With a suite of award-winning and great tasting products, Keef has expanded its presence to 13 legal cannabis markets across North America including Canada and Puerto Rico making it the leading cannabis beverage brand in the country. 

Keef invites everyone – friends, family, newcomers, old-timers, CannaSeurs and CannaCurious – to join us in raising their glasses to the new era of cannabis consumption. To learn more, please visit www.keefbrands.com.

brand.description:
Willamette Valley Alchemy is a community-inspired, craft cannabis company based in the heart of Eugene, Oregon. Their locally owned, family business takes pride in providing Oregon with a large assortment of high-grade cannabis products from the ever-bearing Willamette Valley.

The Willamette Valley serves as a Mecca of agricultural preeminence and abundance, offering some of the most fertile soil in the world. In this newly emerging industry, WVA strives to set a standard of clean, connoisseur choice products from the top producers in the state. WVA works very closely with all of our producers to ensure the product’s quality is consistently AAA grade. From extracts and concentrates to edibles, you can expect only the best. Willamette Valley Alchemy is active in community-building events and activities, making us a company you can stand behind.
